address: Gerrit Rietveld Academie and Sandberg Instituut, Fred. Roeskestraat 96-98, Amsterdam: a 2006 art-school complex, a ten-storey tower clad in dark grey pressed-metal dimples with three long ribbon windows over a glazed ground storey, beside a two-storey low block whose upper storey is a white expanded-metal screen between white slab edges over a glazed ground
notes: Gerrit Rietveld Academie / Sandberg Instituut (BAG pand 0363100012091838, built 2006, 35 3DBAG wall surfaces in two shells, roof max 32.4 m): Fred. Roeskestraat 96-98. Shell 2 is the 40 x 16.5 m tower (eaves 32.3 m, its north top storey set back to 28.3 m), shell 1 the 28.5 x 42.8 m low block (eaves 9.9 m) with a raised lightwell volume to 14.7 m. 3DBAG numbers each shell's wall surfaces from 1, so the groups name their shell (walls[].shell).

walls[0] tower south front (panel 26; crops w03-177a21 2021-04-30 and w03-177d17 2017-12-20, both leaf-off and clear, 30-32 m across the street): dark grey dimpled pressed metal over a dark glazed ground storey (0-3.4 m). Three ribbon windows of square dark-framed panes, 1.2-1.4 m tall: on the first floor in three runs (0-4.7, 11.7-28.3 and 35.6-40.2 m from the west end, sills at 4.3 m), and on two floors near the top across the middle run only (sills 22.0 and 25.6 m), blank metal between and 5.6 m of blank metal above. Storeys fitted to the ribbons: a 3.7 m ground and eight 3.55 m floors to the 32.3 m eaves, ribbons on floors 1, 6 and 7 (openBays, 23 bays of 1.74 m; 9 bays in the middle run where the photo counts 19 panes), windowShape h 0.36 / sill 0.16.

walls[1] tower east wall (panel 25, 16.5 m; crop w07-87far 2022-03-24, 60 m away at 28 degrees through bare branches): the same metal with the first-floor ribbon from 8.9 to 14.7 m and the two upper ribbons from 5.8 to 14.7 m, at the same heights as the south front. The west and north tower walls have no panorama and stay blank metal (otherWalls).

Colours (samplem.mjs boxes on the crops): metal L 75-83 of 255 in the overcast 2017/2021 crops (#545350, #4c4b48) and 167 in the 2022 sun; drawn #5a5955 between them. Ribbon glass #43454a (2021), ground glass #2c302d; frames dark.

walls[2] low block south front (panel 7, 28.5 m; crop w05-177L 2022-03-24, leaf-off in sun; w05-177a21 2021-04-30 overcast): a glazed ground storey (0.6-4.4 m, white mullions, doors) under a white slab edge (4.5-5.3 m), the upper storey a screen of white expanded-metal panels (5.3-9.25 m) between the slab edges, the roof edge at 9.3-9.9 m and a railing above. Sampled: slab edges L 252-254 in sun (137 overcast), screen 217-228 (117-124), ground glass 85 (52). Storeys 2 with groundFactor 0.92 (4.5 m ground under a 5.4 m upper storey); meshScreen panels per 2.6 m bay from 0.15 to 0.88 of the upper storey in #cfd0c8, on white #e9e9e4. One bay (17.9-19.8 m) is a tall clear window where the screen stops (openBays storey 1 bay 7).

walls[3] the low block's west, east and north walls and the lightwell (panels 5, 17, 8, 13, 1; no panorama: the west wall faces the 2001 neighbour, the east wall the yard between the blocks, the north wall the 1967 building's courtyard): inferred as the south front's screen storey over a glazed ground, without the window bay.
The low block was refitted in 2017-18: the 2017-12-20 panorama shows it in scaffolding, glazed, before the screen went up. The tower is unchanged between 2017 and 2025.

Not expressed: the dimple relief of the tower's metal (a smooth stucco wall in its colour), the expanded-metal diamond mesh (smooth pale panels), the small lettering panels on the ground glass (GERRIT RIETVELD ACADEMIE / SANDBERG INSTITUUT, a type-specimen ABC panel, about 1.2 m tall in four lines of 0.2 m letters, too small for the kit's lettering, which needs an entrance hall), the cantilevered east end of the low block's upper storey (3 m over an open passage), the roof railing.

History: installed 2026-10-14 and uninstalled the same day (both street fronts NO EVIDENCE in the 2022-03-24 crops; upper ribbons missing; the low block green-grey instead of white). Re-archived 2026-10-17 with the 2017-12 and 2021-04 captures; the openBays, meshScreen and shell kit fields were added for this building. Note: the earlier install listed OSM way w57860150 (the tower) as an alias.
